name: Otter Watcher Sid

intro.text: Otters came back to the Broads when the rivers got cleaner. Took them till the 1990s. I've been sat here since the 1990s. Fight me, for something to do.

after: Look for spraints on the riverbank: otter poo. It smells of jasmine tea, honestly. That's how you know it's an otter and not a mink. Mink smells of mink.
